description: Full simulated year. Produced by swiss/contract/export_v1.py from real CityLearn 3.3.0 rollouts.
district_note: The six buildings are a constructed composite of representative models from two datasets (HEAPO houses, ETH/EKZ apartment-building heat-pump meters). They are not neighbours, share no grid connection and exchange no energy in the model.
index_convention: UTC, start of hour; step 0 = 2022-12-31T23:00Z = 2023-01-01 00:00 local (D-007). Run arrays and conditions use the same step index (window arrays start at scope.start_step).

controllers.note: identical to no control in this district

scenarios.label: Base district 2023
scenarios.description: Six-building Swiss district, local year 2023, assumed tanks as in D-017a.

hp_sh_kwh_el.label: Heat-pump electricity, space heating
hp_sh_kwh_el.description: Electricity drawn by the space-heating heat pump in this step (direct operation plus charging the heating tank). Under "No control" it reproduces the derived series; under other controllers it is a simulation result.

hp_hw_kwh_el.label: Heat-pump electricity, hot water and other base load
hp_hw_kwh_el.description: Electricity of the second heat-pump device, which serves the warm-weather base load (hot water and other use; A-005).

household_kwh_el.label: Household electricity
household_kwh_el.description: Non-shiftable load: everything except the heat pump. SFH: metered (HEAPO); includes the electric water heater of SFH-mid and SFH-high. MFH: synthetic composite of other EKZ apartments, NOT measured in these buildings (D-015).

net_kwh_el.label: Electricity drawn from the grid
net_kwh_el.description: Heat pumps plus household electricity. No PV or battery in Phase A, so this is also the grid import and is never negative.

cost_chf.label: Electricity cost
cost_chf.description: Grid import of the step times the tariff of the step (EKZ standard 2023, excl. VAT).

sh_demand_kwh_th.label: Heat demand, space heating
sh_demand_kwh_th.description: Derived from measured heat-pump electricity times a modeled COP (M-001). Heat timing is unvalidated (ISS-028, ISS-030). Always met in the model.

hw_demand_kwh_th.label: Heat demand, hot water and other base load
hw_demand_kwh_th.description: Warm-weather baseline of heat-pump electricity times COP. It may include uses other than hot water (SFH-high: ISS-027). SFH-mid and SFH-high heat water electrically; that electricity is in household_kwh_el.

hp_sh_direct_kwh_th.label: Heat pump to demand, space heating
hp_sh_direct_kwh_th.description: Heat delivered by the heat pump straight to the demand.

hp_sh_to_tank_kwh_th.label: Heat pump to tank, space heating
hp_sh_to_tank_kwh_th.description: Heat the heat pump puts into the tank (before tank losses).

sh_tank_to_demand_kwh_th.label: Tank to demand, space heating
sh_tank_to_demand_kwh_th.description: Stored heat delivered to the demand in this step.

sh_tank_loss_kwh_th.label: Tank losses, space heating
sh_tank_loss_kwh_th.description: Heat lost in the tank (round-trip efficiency and standby loss) = into tank - out of tank - change in stored heat. Depends on assumed tank efficiency and loss rate (ISS-032).

sh_tank_soc.label: Tank fill level, space heating
sh_tank_soc.description: Stored heat relative to the (assumed) tank capacity at the end of the step.

sh_tank_action.label: Controller command, space heating tank
sh_tank_action.description: Command passed to CityLearn: positive = charge, negative = discharge. It is NOT the executed flow (limits apply); use the *_to_tank and *_to_demand variables for what happened.

sh_tank_mode.label: Tank state, space heating
sh_tank_mode.description: charging | discharging | idle, from the executed flows (threshold in situation_thresholds.flow_epsilon_kwh_th).

cop_sh.label: Heat-pump COP, space heating
cop_sh.description: Carnot-fraction COP at the outdoor temperature of the step (M-001); eta calibrated to a literature SPF (D-014d).

hp_hw_direct_kwh_th.label: Heat pump to demand, hot water and other base load
hp_hw_direct_kwh_th.description: Heat delivered by the heat pump straight to the demand.

hp_hw_to_tank_kwh_th.label: Heat pump to tank, hot water and other base load
hp_hw_to_tank_kwh_th.description: Heat the heat pump puts into the tank (before tank losses).
hp_hw_to_tank_kwh_th.absent_when: no hot-water tank in this building

hw_tank_to_demand_kwh_th.label: Tank to demand, hot water and other base load
hw_tank_to_demand_kwh_th.description: Stored heat delivered to the demand in this step.
hw_tank_to_demand_kwh_th.absent_when: no hot-water tank in this building

hw_tank_loss_kwh_th.label: Tank losses, hot water and other base load
hw_tank_loss_kwh_th.description: Heat lost in the tank (round-trip efficiency and standby loss) = into tank - out of tank - change in stored heat. Depends on assumed tank efficiency and loss rate (ISS-032).
hw_tank_loss_kwh_th.absent_when: no hot-water tank in this building

hw_tank_soc.label: Tank fill level, hot water and other base load
hw_tank_soc.description: Stored heat relative to the (assumed) tank capacity at the end of the step.
hw_tank_soc.absent_when: no hot-water tank in this building

hw_tank_action.label: Controller command, hot water and other base load tank
hw_tank_action.description: Command passed to CityLearn: positive = charge, negative = discharge. It is NOT the executed flow (limits apply); use the *_to_tank and *_to_demand variables for what happened.
hw_tank_action.absent_when: no hot-water tank in this building

hw_tank_mode.label: Tank state, hot water and other base load
hw_tank_mode.description: charging | discharging | idle, from the executed flows (threshold in situation_thresholds.flow_epsilon_kwh_th).
hw_tank_mode.absent_when: no hot-water tank in this building

cop_hw.label: Heat-pump COP, hot water and other base load
cop_hw.description: Carnot-fraction COP at the outdoor temperature of the step (M-001); eta calibrated to a literature SPF (D-014d).

net_kwh_el.label: District grid import
net_kwh_el.description: Sum of the six buildings (all non-negative in Phase A).

hp_kwh_el.label: District heat-pump electricity
hp_kwh_el.description: Both heat-pump devices of all buildings.

household_kwh_el.label: District household electricity
household_kwh_el.description: Sum of household electricity (MFH part synthetic).

hw_demand_kwh_th.label: District heat demand, hot water and other base load

reward.label: Reward R-001
reward.description: Sum of the three parts below (carbon weight 0).

reward_cost.label: Reward part: cost
reward_cost.description: Already weighted and scaled; negative = penalty.

reward_peak.label: Reward part: peak
reward_peak.description: Squared district draw, weighted and scaled.

reward_ramp.label: Reward part: ramping
reward_ramp.description: Change of district draw, weighted and scaled.

diffuse_wm2.label: Diffuse horizontal irradiance
diffuse_wm2.description: One missing hour is set to 0 in the canonical file (see QC report).

price_chf_kwh.label: Electricity tariff
price_chf_kwh.description: Published EKZ standard two-tier tariff 2023, excl. VAT (a price schedule, not a metered quantity; the registry classifies it as measured).

carbon_relative_rank.label: Grid carbon intensity, relative rank
carbon_relative_rank.unit: percent of the year's hours with lower intensity
carbon_relative_rank.description: Rank of the hour inside the modeled 2023 series (1-99). The absolute level is about 61-63 % of the EPFL reference, so no absolute value is exported.

situation_tags.cold_hour: One of the coldest 10 % of hours of the year outdoors.
situation_tags.high_tariff: A high-tariff hour (weekdays, 07:00 to 20:00 local time).
situation_tags.district_daily_peak: The hour with the highest electricity draw of its day, all six buildings together.
situation_tags.sh_tank_charging: The heating tank is being charged by the heat pump.
situation_tags.sh_tank_discharging: The heating tank is supplying stored heat to the demand.
situation_tags.sh_tank_idle: The heating tank is neither charging nor discharging.
situation_tags.sh_tank_full: The heating tank is almost full (99 % or more).
situation_tags.sh_tank_empty: The heating tank is almost empty (1 % or less).
situation_tags.sh_tank_covers_demand: The heating tank supplies at least 50 % of the heat demand it serves.
situation_tags.hw_tank_charging: The hot-water and base-load tank is being charged by the heat pump.
situation_tags.hw_tank_discharging: The hot-water and base-load tank is supplying stored heat to the demand.
situation_tags.hw_tank_idle: The hot-water and base-load tank is neither charging nor discharging.
situation_tags.hw_tank_full: The hot-water and base-load tank is almost full (99 % or more).
situation_tags.hw_tank_empty: The hot-water and base-load tank is almost empty (1 % or less).
situation_tags.hw_tank_covers_demand: The hot-water and base-load tank supplies at least 50 % of the heat demand it serves.
situation_tags.hp_sh_near_capacity: The space-heating heat pump is running at 95 % or more of its nominal electrical power.

units.kW_el: mean electrical power over a step = kWh_el / (step_seconds / 3600)
units.kW_th: mean thermal power over a step = kWh_th / (step_seconds / 3600)
